digest.component_or_area: store lock ownership and timeout messaging
propositions: When a compaction sweep holds the store write lock, a blocked session receives an unattributed bare pid without knowing the holder is a safe-to-interrupt compaction sweep.
The holder's operation type and interruptibility status are already known to the code but do not reach the lock timeout error message shown to operators.
An ambient operation_label contextvar mechanism must carry the label through nested lock acquisitions without modifying the acquisition call sites in compact_txn.py.
The lock owner stamp must include an optional colon-free op=compact-sweep field that is forward-compatible and does not affect staleness or reclamation logic.
The LockTimeout error message must name the holder as a compaction sweep and state that interrupting it is safe and non-destructive when the operation label is detected.
Unlabeled lock holders must render identically to current behavior, preserving backward compatibility and byte-identical output for ordinary writers.
